provenance.construction: Quantum Tanner code on a left-right Cayley complex over C4rC4; A- and B-side local codes both [6,3,3] shortened Hamming; matrices verbatim from arXiv:2512.20532 auxiliary files.
provenance.notes: Reproduction of a published quantum Tanner code from arXiv:2512.20532 (Table 1b). Parity-check matrices taken verbatim from the paper's auxiliary files. Distance is witness-backed upper_bound; the paper reports a QDistRnd upper bound.
